prompt: You are a Rust coding assistant working inside the current directory. Use the tools to inspect and change code: ls, read_file, write_file, edit_file (a sed script), and cargo (check, build, test, run). All paths are relative to the current directory. If there is no Cargo.toml here, run cargo with args 'init --lib' or 'init' to start a project IN PLACE - do not use cargo new, which nests a subdirectory. If you do work in a subdirectory project, pass its dir to the cargo tool. Verify your work with cargo before answering, and finish with a short summary of what you did. If edit_file reports that nothing changed, do not retry the same script - rewrite the whole file with write_file instead.

tools.name: ls
tools.description: List files under a directory (directories end with /).

params.name: path
params.description: Relative directory, default the current one.

tools.command: path="${path:-.}"; case "$path" in /*|*..*) echo "error: path must stay under the current directory"; exit 0;; esac; ls -p -- "$path"

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file under the current directory.
tools.command: case "$path" in /*|*..*) echo "error: path must stay under the current directory"; exit 0;; esac; cat -- "$path"

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file under the current directory.
tools.command: case "$path" in /*|*..*) echo "error: path must stay under the current directory"; exit 0;; esac; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")" && printf '%s' "$content" > "$path" && echo "wrote $path ($(wc -c < "$path" | tr -d ' ') bytes)"

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a file in place with a sed script (BSD sed), e.g. 's/foo/bar/g' or '3d'.
tools.command: case "$path" in /*|*..*) echo "error: path must stay under the current directory"; exit 0;; esac; tmp=$(mktemp); cp -- "$path" "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { echo "error: cannot read $path"; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 0; }; sed -i '' -e "$script" -- "$path" 2>&1 || { echo "error: sed rejected the script"; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 0; }; if cmp -s "$tmp" "$path"; then echo "error: no changes made - the script matched nothing in $path; rewrite the file with write_file instead of retrying"; else echo "edited $path:"; diff -u "$tmp" "$path" | tail -n +3; fi; rm -f "$tmp"

tools.name: cargo
tools.description: Run cargo with the given arguments, e.g. 'check', 'test', 'run --quiet'. Runs in the current directory; pass dir to run inside a subdirectory project.

params.name: dir
params.description: Relative directory to run in, default the current one.

tools.command: dir="${dir:-.}"; case "$dir" in /*|*..*) echo "error: dir must stay under the current directory"; exit 0;; esac; cd -- "$dir" 2>/dev/null || { echo "error: no such directory: $dir"; exit 0; }; cargo $args 2>&1 | tail -c 3500
